description: Patch schema for local Chatterbox text-to-speech with a reference voice audio prompt.

unmapped_ui_parameters.audio_length: The pinned FL_ChatterboxTTS node does not expose a duration control; output length follows text and reference prosody.
unmapped_ui_parameters.speed: The standard Chatterbox TTS node exposes cfg_weight/pace, not a direct speed control.
unmapped_ui_parameters.remove_silence: The pinned Chatterbox node pack does not expose silence trimming in this node.
unmapped_ui_parameters.speech_to_speech_vc: True two-audio voice conversion is handled by chatterbox_vc_comfy; this workflow is zero-shot reference TTS.

output.contract: Return one readable FLAC audio artifact generated by the local Chatterbox TTS node with a reference audio prompt.
